scale_basis: Nominal 5m artwork; source fossil proportions interpreted conservatively, not specimen measurements.
surface: opaque single-sided closed palette-only low-poly solids

origin_repair.scope: origin-only; no shape, pose, scale or material redesign
origin_repair.root_and_mesh_transform_policy: identity; bake one identical translation into every mesh vertex
origin_repair.transform_normalization: Bake existing common r001 Z grounding transform into vertices before origin-only XY translation; no added world-space Z displacement, modulo float32 coordinate storage.
